ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the rider's claim is upheld in part. The platform's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02858) measures 27.69 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off against the booked optimal of 21.3 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02858) — an excess of 6.39 km, or 30.0% of the optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass (above 0.8 km and above 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The trace governs, not the rounded 27.7 km copy on the trip record. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 218 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so no limb (a)–(c) fires and no independent corroboration is required; POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The deviation is established but NOT MATERIAL (6.39 km is below 8.0 km and 30.0% is below 50%), so the POL-RD-06 profile check is not mandatory; the driver's profile in any case shows deviation_flags_90d of 1 against 309 completed trips in 90 days, a ratio of 0.0032 — no pattern, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral.

No exculpatory clause applies. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02858-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run and the driver's explanation 'Followed navigation' names no artifact and carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not triggered by it (POL-RD-13(1)). The chat log (EV-CHAT-02858) is empty, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 can be run; no pickup or drop-off was amended and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The booked optimal of 21.3 km therefore stands.

Remedy under POL-RD-02, on the booked optimal route (fare model METERED and quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply): charged_total SGD 35.52 (EV-FARE-02858); recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 21.3 + 0.28 × 28.8) × 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = SGD 28.6390; refund = 35.52 − 28.6390 = SGD 6.8810, rounded up to SGD 6.90. The surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, the only artifact carrying it. The refund is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 19.37% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.90. No ERP or surcharge correction is added on top: the fare breakdown carries no ERP gantries and no airport surcharge, and any off-route pass-through would already be comprehended in the POL-RD-02 figure. The refund of SGD 6.90 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold, so it executes on issue, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04.

For transparency: the referee discarded the driver-side claim about the missing advisory because it cited EV-ADVIS-02858-01 without disclosing that artifact's impairment; the same point, properly disclosed, was made and kept on the rider's side and is accepted above.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
